# Vendor Dependencies

This folder contains offline vendor dependencies for OpenPDF Studio to ensure 100% local operation without external network dependencies.

## PDF.js (v3.11.174)
- Source: Mozilla PDF.js (Apache License 2.0)
- Files:
  - `pdf.js`: Core PDF parsing and rendering runtime
  - `pdf.worker.js`: Web Worker script for off-thread PDF rendering
  - `pdf_viewer.css`: Text layer selection overlay styles
- License: Apache License 2.0 (see https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/master/LICENSE)
